claim_boundary: This is a necessary permanent-source falsifier for a separately identified MACE-MDP-based independent quadratic polarization model. It does not treat MACE-MDP as an energy model, admit a common KKT scalar, select a solvation ledger, or admit E/F/H/V/M.

candidate.permanent_source: unchanged atom-resolved charges and Cartesian dipoles emitted by the frozen checkpoint
candidate.surface_map: exact exterior point-multipole potential through l<=1; no Gaussian width, radial mixture, fitting, or clipping
candidate.response_role_if_this_gate_passes: the separately audited molecular polarizability and atomic induced-dipole partition may enter a later explicit quadratic common-scalar KKT gate

parent_pcmsolver_preregistration.reuse_boundary: Only frozen geometries, QM MEPs, intrinsic cavities, dielectric convention, and PCMSolver identity are reused. No prior MACE source result is reused.

admission_gates.threshold_provenance: The 1 kcal/mol fixed-source budget is inherited unchanged from the already frozen four-case representation gate and was not selected from MACE-MDP outcomes.

terminal_decision.failure: Reject the unchanged MACE-MDP permanent atomic-moment source for quantitative PCM and close this untrained independent-polarization candidate. Do not add a radial fit, rescale charges/dipoles, or tune against solvation energy. A successor requires a newly trained scalar-first permanent-source/polarization head or another independently source-validated model.
terminal_decision.success: Authorize only the broader twelve-geometry static-MEP gate and explicit quadratic common-scalar KKT construction using the already audited polarizability/induced-source coefficients. No capability is admitted by this four-case pass.
